scope: Packaging existing approved/static-audited assets only. No game, world assembly, procedural generation, publishing or PC import performed.
transform_convention: Column vectors. Source yaw in degrees around +Z. Convert matrices with C M C^-1. Do not convert GLB axes twice.

collision_contract.visual_geometry: Actual exported meshes, including walls, roofs, door leaves, furniture, trunks, branches and canopies.
collision_contract.declared_boxes: Authoring intent only. Boxes do not replace the triangle audit or engine-specific cooking.
collision_contract.navigation: No engine navmesh or gameplay controller is bundled. Source graph is intent; natural terrain requires triangle support and walkable_routes.
collision_contract.soft_geometry: See each clearance report for explicit soft foliage/decor exclusions.
collision_contract.doors: Authored open poses. Door animation and a closed-state traversal system are not included.
collision_contract.terrain: If replace_floor_meshes is true, do not instantiate legacy floor cells over terrain_meshes.

tower_identity: Tower of Chrysanthus is the consuming game name for existing Tower kit. No bespoke exterior or 100-floor vertical shell is supplied.

seeded_floor_guidance.status: Input asset pool only; no seeded floors generated or certified
seeded_floor_guidance.seed_contract_suggestion: Store worldSeed, floorIndex (1..100), generatorVersion and selected asset IDs/transforms. Use a fixed documented PRNG in the consuming game.
seeded_floor_guidance.assembly_rule: Match port position and elevation, opposite outward normals, compatible support band and aperture; apply transforms to geometry and metadata. Reject any non-seam geometry overlap and disconnected support. Preserve at least one entrance-to-exit route.
seeded_floor_guidance.height_rule: Read stair upper-port Z values (2.4/3.6/4.8m); do not assume constant story height or stack overlapping shells. Separate floor instances/loading is an implementation option, not an authored asset feature.
seeded_floor_guidance.branch_rule: Unused connectors require validated existing-component closure or an inaccessible boundary. Raw rooms expose open ports; no automatically sealed layout is supplied.
seeded_floor_guidance.variation_rule: Use included audited hall/junction/stair/side-room variants. Validate every assembled layout and final controller; do not invent replacement geometry when assembly fails.

limitations: Static sampled clearance is not final controller, camera, animated-door, interaction, navmesh or connected-world certification.
House connectors are corrected, nongrid doorway thresholds; old V2 house transforms and 4m seam assumptions are invalid. Home-to-street support and collision require separate runtime integration.
Loose components retain authoring collider intent; colliders may be absent/incomplete and need engine cooking.
Natural terrain uses actual terrain_meshes and walkable_routes. Never duplicate legacy floor cells when replace_floor_meshes is true.
Only selected source assets are included. Metadata placements are descriptive of baked GLBs, not a request to instantiate a second copy.
